notes.text: i — Bb minor, the home chord

Bass walks Bb, Ab, Gb (i, bVII, bVI). The Gb feels like an arrival but not home: the music uses C natural, which Gb major would spell Cb, so the key stays Bb minor. A sus chord has no third, so it passes through without settling.

notes.note: passing chord as the bass walks down from Bb to Gb

notes.text: bVII — Ab sus chord, a passing chord on the way down

notes.note: I was surprised to hear a major nine in this song since it is so sad. I guess I don't completely understand how a major nine is supposed to sound I expected it to be somewhat happy for some reason

notes.text: bVI — Gb major (maj9), a major chord native to the minor key; the bass lands here after walking Bb, Ab, Gb
